scripts.setup-app: composer install && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const data = fs.readFileSync('.env.example'); fs.writeFileSync('.env', data); fs.writeFileSync('database/database.sqlite', '') " && php artisan key:generate
scripts.setup-database: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('database/database.sqlite', '') " && php artisan migrate:refresh --seed
scripts.setup-all: npm run setup-app && npm run setup-database
